overview.description: The First Trust Global Wind Energy ETF (FAN) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the ISE Clean Edge Global Wind Energy index. The fund tracks an index of companies involved in the wind energy industry, weighted according to float-adjusted market cap with strict limits on individual holdings. FAN was launched on Jun 16, 2008 and is issued by First Trust.
